comment: Values the design system states in a component README but does not carry in tokens.json. Each one cites the sentence it comes from. They live here so no component ever hand-writes a size - verify.ts G2 depends on that.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.source: components/Verdict/README.md - 'Glyph 9px at radius-round - the only round shape in the system.'
tokens.offGrid: The one off-grid value in the system. It is a glyph diameter, not spacing, and 8px reads as a bullet while 12px reads as a button.

tokens.name: dot-ring
tokens.source: components/Verdict/preview.html - the hollow ABSTAINED dot is an inset ring; matches border-rule.

tokens.name: field-column
tokens.source: components/Attestation/README.md - 'label keys against mono values at a 132px column'.

tokens.name: logo-sm
tokens.source: components/Logotype/README.md - the small variant covers '24px and below'.

tokens.name: logo-lg
tokens.source: Derived: the next step on the 4px grid used for page headers.

tokens.name: logo-xl
tokens.source: Derived: the hero lockup, matching display-xl's 96px font-size.

tokens.name: pane-max
tokens.source: Sized to the terminal's own convention: 80 columns of Martian Mono at 13px measure 728px, plus space-6 of padding and a hairline either side. components/Terminal/preview.html uses 690px, which fits its own sample run but cuts a realistic abstain clause, and the README is explicit that a verdict list must not wrap.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.source: Derived: page gutter space-12 either side of a 1024px measure.

tokens.name: bp-stack
tokens.source: Derived: the width at which the attestation's 132px label column stops fitting beside its value.

tokens.name: bp-page
tokens.source: Derived: the width at which the space-12 page gutter costs more than it gives.

tokens.name: step-column
tokens.source: Derived: the width of a two-digit step number at `mono-sm`, on the 4px grid. Separate from field-column, which is the attestation's 132px label column.

tokens.name: bp-field
tokens.source: Derived: the card width below which the attestation's 132px label column no longer leaves room for its value. A container query, not a viewport one.
